description: Unit test class for the GrantRevokeIndex class, testing its behavior and correctness in managing permission grants and revocations within a trie-based access control system.

classes.name: GrantRevokeIndexTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the functionality of GrantRevokeIndex, including equality, permission checks, and subject ID effects.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants before any tests run.

methods.name: initTestVariables
methods.description: Sets up test data before each test execution.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that GrantRevokeIndex correctly implements hashCode and equals.

methods.name: getGrantedReturnsExpected
methods.description: Assertions for the getGranted method of GrantRevokeIndex.

methods.name: getRevokedReturnsExpected
methods.description: Assertions for the getRevoked method of GrantRevokeIndex.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeightReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that copying the index with decremented weight works as expected.

methods.name: tryToOverrideByNull
methods.description: Checks that overriding with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: overrideByReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that overrideBy correctly merges updates.

methods.name: subjectIdHasReadAndWritePermissions
methods.description: Verifies that a subject with permissions has correct access.

methods.name: anotherSubjectIdHasNoWritePermission
methods.description: Verifies that a subject lacks write permission after revocation.

methods.name: anotherSubjectIdHasNoReadPermissionBecauseRevokedWithSameWeight
methods.description: Checks that read permission is revoked when weight is equal.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIdsForReadPermissionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of subject IDs affected by 'read' permission.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIdsForWritePermissionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of subject IDs affected by 'write' permission.
